Samir Rao: Quick follow-up from todays all-hands: when marketing asks for dates, what exact wording should we use around API/Console/Optimize availability? Need something safe but useful for partners.

Priya Nadar: Short and safe: "Core SDK streaming: GA targeted end of Q2. Console per-route dashboards: early access in Q3. Optimize recommendations: early access in late Q3, GA targeted in Q4 pending pilot feedback." Emphasize pilots and performance validation.

Marcus Lee: Engineering note: the streaming SDK GA depends on one remaining perf sweep for long-tail sequences. If regression >5% we ship with fallback and call out reduced throughput for affected model families.

Tracy Kim: Can we get a one-line partner blurb we can paste into emails?

Elena Ortiz: Suggested blurb: "We expect core streaming features to reach GA by end of Q2. New Console dashboards and Optimize cost/performance recommendations will be available as early access in Q3, with general availability in Q4 after pilot validation and performance sign-off. Dedicated/private customers can request early access via Solutions."

Marcus Lee: Also: rollout plan is internal -> small pilot group -> opt-in beta -> GA. Each step is telemetry-gated (~1-3 weeks between steps).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment for streaming-sdk started by @Marcus Lee at 2026-03-23T18:05:00Z, perf tests queued.

Samir Rao: Perfect. Tracy, please prep the partner note using Elenas phrasing and tag Priya. Marcus, post the perf-sweep result here when ready.

Tracy Kim: On it  will share a draft by tomorrow morning.

Marcus Lee: Will post numbers within 72 hours.

Samir Rao: Thanks all.
